notes.title: 【You've received a New Message】English Localization Update
notes.content:
Dear Wanderer User,

Thanks to the hard work of our localizer @Max Ponoroff , Dreamline404 now features professionally localized English text for a smoother and more immersive experience.

You can now enjoy the game with better clarity and accuracy (no more awkward phrasing or strange wording) :p

We truly appreciate everyone who has played and supported the game so far. Your feedback has been truly invaluable. 

Meanwhile, we’ve been working on our new project [b][i]Dark Compass[/i][/b], hopefully we'll release the steam page soon.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45162762/7a626ccfed2f1a10a5057d377bb94e42fd4454ce.png[/img]
